title: Three Way Invoice Match
description: Matches one invoice against its purchase order and its goods receipt and decides whether the invoice can be paid: explicit line pairing (declared po_line, then exact sku, then a free same-number PO line; no fuzzy text matching), a fixed first-apply line-verdict order (quantity over received, receipt missing as a two-way flag, quantity over ordered, price outside the declared basis-point tolerance with the boundary passing), integer minor-unit totals with half-up tax from one declared rate, and duplicate-invoice screening against same-vendor priors on the normalized invoice number, same total inside the declared day window, or the same PO. Fractional quantities and sub-minor-unit prices are refused with a named reason, never rounded; one currency per invoice; no tax-jurisdiction logic; day differences come from integer days-from-civil arithmetic with no clock.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the single currency this invoice is declared in; required.

invoice.description: The invoice under test: invoice_number, issue_date (YYYY-MM-DD), vendor_id, po_number, subtotal_minor, tax_minor, total_minor, and lines[] each carrying line, optional po_line, optional sku, qty (integer > 0), unit_price_minor, amount_minor.

purchase_order.description: The referenced purchase order: po_number and lines[] each carrying line, optional sku, qty (integer > 0), unit_price_minor. Optional; absence makes the run a no_po outcome.

goods_receipt.description: The goods receipt: receipt_id and lines[] each carrying po_line and qty_received (integer >= 0). Optional; absence downgrades the run to a two-way match reported per line as receipt_missing.

prior_invoices.description: Earlier invoices from the same vendor for duplicate screening: id, vendor_id, invoice_number, issue_date, total_minor, po_number. Optional.

duplicate_window_days.description: Day window for the within-window duplicate reason; |day difference| <= window counts as inside.

mcp_tool_definition.name: match_invoice_three_way
mcp_tool_definition.description: Matches an invoice against its purchase order and goods receipt in integer minor units, with explicit line pairing (declared po_line, then exact sku, then a free same-number PO line), a fixed first-apply line-verdict order, half-up tax from one declared rate, and same-vendor duplicate screening on the normalized invoice number, same total inside the day window, or same PO. Refuses fractional quantities, sub-minor prices, negative or non-integer money, duplicate line numbers, unknown tax roundings and a missing currency with named reasons; outcome match | mismatch | no_po | refused.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: currency, invoice, purchase_order, goods_receipt, vendor_terms, prior_invoices, duplicate_window_days.
author: PostOakLabs

output_example.scope_note: Integer minor units only: fractional quantities and sub-minor-unit prices are refused, not rounded. One currency per invoice. One declared tax rate; no tax-jurisdiction logic.
